metadata.description: Color models, multi-stop gradient architectures (linear, radial, conic), and sRGB parity

gradient.distribution_formula: offset_i = i / (N - 1) when stop percentages are omitted

gradient.example: circle #glow { size: 700px; fill: radial-gradient(circle, alpha(#87CC2E, 0.35) 0%, alpha(#101612, 0) 70%); }
gradient.rule: Vibrant Glow Alphas >= 0.25: In sRGB display profiles, low alphas are crushed by display gamma. Center stop alpha must be >= 0.25 for visible neon glow.

gradient.svg_parity: SVG exporter synthesizes a high-res 6-degree polygonal wedge pattern to achieve visual parity since SVG lacks native conicGradient.

srgb_interpolation_parity.description: TOAD SVG exporter sets color-interpolation="sRGB" on all gradients to prevent dark desaturated bands present in linearRGB default.
